title: Gender stereotypes in dance education: a study of implicit biases and intervention strategies in the teaching process
core_idea: Investigate the prevalence and manifestations of gender stereotypes and implicit biases in dance education using a mixed-methods approach (surveys, interviews, classroom observations) and explore intervention strategies to address bias in teaching practices.
tldr: Examines how gender stereotypes and implicit biases operate in dance education and explores intervention strategies to inform more equitable teaching.
